cryptoTitle: Holding coins and trading the trend
equityConclusion: All completed daily stock-selection proxies lost money at 20/40 bps one-way costs. At the original timing, Ridge trailed simple reversal in both comparable windows.
cryptoConclusion: Weekly trend is sensitive to execution timing. It has not shown a stable advantage over the matched-target-exposure control.
summaryContext: The counts below cover every requested window at the selected cost and timing.
equityIntro: Four methods use the same candidate data and cost assumptions. These are historical price-and-cost estimates. Security identity and executable prices still need acceptance.
cryptoIntro: Compare holding the eight coins with a fixed allocation and weekly trend rules. Change the cost or execution delay to inspect the same historical window.
equitySummary: Ridge exceeded equal weight in {wins} of {comparable} comparable windows.
cryptoSummary: Weekly trend exceeded buy and hold in {wins} of {comparable} comparable windows.
blockedSummary: Another {blocked} requested windows could not be compared.
feeHelp: 20 bps means 0.2% of traded value. These are assumed total costs.
equityTiming: Stock trades use the next exchange session. Delaying adds one more exact session. All positions close within that session, with costs on both entry and exit.
cryptoTiming: Crypto decisions use a daily close proxy. Delaying shifts both the target and trade calendar by one UTC day, keeping cash before the initial trade.
returnChart: Estimated return in the selected window
costChart: How the estimate changes with cost
chartNote: Only calculated scenarios appear. Missing values remain unavailable; the table retains the reasons.
costNote: Each point is a separate account calculation at the stated cost.
drawdown: Largest loss from a prior peak
equityRisk: Equal weight uses all candidates with a usable signal-day price. The three ranking methods choose 50. Their concentration differs, so return differences include that risk difference.
equityLimit: Each window starts at normalized NAV1, denominated in USD, and requests 20 signal dates. Entry and exit use the first and last usable regular-session trade. These prices do not establish executable fills.
cryptoLimit: Each 90-day window starts at normalized NAV1, denominated in USDT. Buy and hold and the fixed 60% allocation carry different risk from trend. The matched control matches target exposure at scheduled trades. Realized weights can drift afterwards. Final holdings are marked without a terminal sale.
stressTitle: Does the result depend on a few opportunities?
share: Largest asset share of positive price PnL
removed: Return with the five best days held in cash
stressNote: These are ex-post diagnostics. The five days are chosen after seeing their results and do not supply a usable timing rule. Asset shares use positive price PnL as the denominator.
unusable: Rows without usable OHLC, including missing prices
minuteScope: The minute check covers one fixed row group, including pre/post-market records. Full conversion completion is the converter's reported status.
future: The future observation proposal is frozen and awaiting fresh data with verified availability. Historical replays remain a separate evidence stage.
guide: Read the data and comparison method

reasons.MISSING_EXECUTION_SESSION: Execution session outside the retained range
reasons.MISSING_SELECTED_OUTCOME: A selected candidate has no usable outcome
